title: Product Decomposition Contract
purpose: Defines the directional, non-normative contract for product decomposition documents.

normative_requirements.text: A product decomposition shall be stored under `docs/decompositions/` and shall use the canonical top-level `*-DECOMPOSITION.md` controlling document plus subordinate chunks.

A product decomposition shall record the controlling product overview, controlling documents, predecessor documents, evidence, bounded product areas, stable product-area identifiers, each area's purpose, responsibilities, boundaries, dependencies, exclusions, cross-cutting concerns, unresolved decisions, likely successor planning or specification work, decomposition stopping criteria, and the authorized next planning action.

A product decomposition shall remain directional and non-normative and shall not define exact product behavior, select implementation architecture without later authority, accept product specifications, or conceal unresolved semantic decisions.
The top-level controlling document shall act as the index, status declaration, and navigation entry point for the decomposition composite document.
A product decomposition shall keep each bounded area coherent and shall not mix unrelated lifecycle stages or authority domains within one area.
A product decomposition shall make the next authorized planning action explicit so later work does not have to infer it from conversation history.
